sources.entry: Hlido — Proof-backed AI agent review desk. Each agent gets a Laddoo Score (0-100), claim-vs-evidence audit, C2PA-signed screenshots, public Hugging Face dataset, and a 9-tool MCP server (hlido.eu/mcp) for agent trust checks.

summary.name: Hlido
summary.one_liner: Hlido is a Prague-based AI and automation implementation consultancy that advises on, designs, builds, integrates and supports business technology systems, with cybersecurity delivered through partner IrisInfosec.
use_cases: Get advice on AI adoption and what to build, buy or leave alone
Prepare for EU AI Act compliance with a gap list
Build and integrate AI or automation into existing business systems
Outsource post-go-live monitoring and fixes for software
Commission penetration testing and security gap assessments through a partner
Enter the Czech or EU market as an Indian company
summary.what_it_does: The page describes Hlido as an implementation partner that runs work in four stages: ideation and strategy, design and development, delivery with acceptance testing against an agreed list, and post-production support such as monitoring and fixes. It offers written advisory on technology strategy, architecture, vendor selection, AI adoption and EU AI Act readiness. Security services (regulatory compliance, risk and gap assessment, VAPT, AI security and governance, threat intelligence, endpoint protection, SOC/NOC) are delivered with channel partner IrisInfosec. The page also says Hlido acts as a point of contact for Indian companies entering the EU and European companies working with India. Engagements are scoped and quoted in writing before work starts.
notable: Four-stage engagement from ideation to post-production support, scoped and quoted in writing
Security services delivered with channel partner IrisInfosec under one point of contact
Prague-based point of contact for Indian and EU companies, member of EU India Chambers
caveats: Pricing is not published; engagements are quoted individually in writing
Services are consulting and implementation, not a self-serve software product
The listing's claims about a Laddoo Score, MCP server and Hugging Face dataset are not described on the page itself and were not verified here
